note: Paper only. Forward test book `news_event` since 2026-11-10. No broker API. Long on clearly bullish news (acquisition target, big contract, FDA approval, guidance raise); short on clearly bearish (fraud/probe, guidance cut, short-seller report, dilutive offering). 5% equity, max 6, hold 2 days, hard 8% stop both sides. Entry at next tradable price. Paper shorts — no borrow model. FORWARD-TEST NOTE (2026-11-10): NVDA short was a FALSE POSITIVE — entered on a law-firm 'INVESTOR ALERT' / class-action solicitation PR (Hagens Berman) that name-dropped DOJ; not a real SEC/DOJ action or company 8-K. Position left open as part of the forward-test record. Tagging now filters shareholder-alert spam out of fraud_probe.
